basics.name: Jeeva Ananth V
basics.label: Software Engineer (Machine Learning)
basics.summary: Software Engineer (Machine Learning) specializing in Generative AI, NLP, and Agentic AI systems. Experienced in architecting, training, and deploying LLM-powered, RAG-based enterprise applications including KnitiBot, leveraging pgvector and Kafka-driven data pipelines for real-time knowledge orchestration. Skilled in production-grade ML engineering involving model optimization (TensorRT, ONNX), secure FastAPI microservices, and on-device inference on Raspberry Pi 5. Demonstrated success delivering measurable performance gains including 20% latency reduction and 15% accuracy improvement. Currently advancing multi-agent MCP-enabled architectures for emotionally intelligent AI systems.

work.name: Count AI

Contributed to SuperNova, a compact AI-powered knitting monitoring machine built on Raspberry Pi 5 with an AI accelerator HAT, running optimized on-device ML inference for pattern detection and machine control.
Containerized and deployed ML inference services using Docker with scalable production deployment workflows, enabling resilient rollouts, observability, and high-availability model serving.
